justification: The only notable overlap is very general: both include profile figural imagery and some feather- or wing-like linear forms, but A’s content is a single large winged anthropomorphic figure with raised hand and held object, while B is a multi-register field of schematic animals and signs. The biggest difference is that A presents one integrated standing supernatural/person-like figure, whereas B presents several separate animal/symbol motifs arranged in horizontal bands with no comparable central figure or gesture.
